newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony to launch desktop PCs in Japan in 1997/98.
newsitem.headline: Sony to launch desktop PCs in Japan in 1997/98.

text.p: Sony Corp said on Friday it plans to launch desktop personal computers (PCs) in Japan in the 1997/98 business year and is considering selling notebook PCs in the United States in the future.

"We plan to launch desktop PCs in Japan this fiscal year but cannot disclose the details at this moment. We are also studying offering notebook PCs in the United States sometime in the future," a Sony spokesman told Reuters.
Sony launched its first desktop PCs, the VAIO series, in the United States last September and introduced two new desktop models based on Intel Corp's MMX chip in January.
Sony is also planning to offer desktop PCs in Europe but has yet to decide on the details, he said.
Asked about Sony's PC sales in the United States, the spokesman said: "We never disclose our PC sales figures but they have been pretty good."
